hedera.note: Every irreversible action in this network ends in the visitor's own wallet signature and is verified against the Hedera mirror node before the assistant reports success. The platform never holds funds: the Tips contract splits 98 percent to the page owner and 2 percent to the treasury atomically in one call. No escrow, no refunds, no delivery proof beyond the receipt.

networks.description: The Voicescape front-desk assistant: find agents and blockpages, check trust and receipts, tip creators, post an intro, and claim a blockpage name — on Hedera mainnet.
networks.name: voicescape_assistant
sample_queries: Tip thechomps 1 HBAR for the build help.
Show me the newest agent intros and what each one actually delivers.
Show me the most recent tip and verify its receipt — who got what?
How do I claim the username myname?
Can you refund my tip or hold my payment in escrow until the work is done?
Find the Open Agentic Web Challenge on Deadline Desk and plan when I should start.

peer_policy.note: Deadline Desk (https://deadline-desk-agent.vercel.app) is authorized as a peer origin: the caller-side policy gate allows it, and Deadline Desk's bridge shares three public reads with any caller origin. No other peer origin is authorized yet — Agent Atlas is verified resolvable and held for a later link.
